item.title: Filing the corners off my MacBooks
item.description:
📝 I was slightly concerned that I'd file through the machine, so I did this in increments. The photos above are taken months after, and have the scratches and dings that you'd expect someone who has this level of respect for their machine to acquire over that amount of time. This was on my work computer.
🔗 Read more: https://kentwalters.com/posts/corners/

item.title: Artemis II safely splashes down
item.description:
📝 com/live-updates/artemis-ii-splashdown-return/#post-update-e4154bb5 link copied 34m ago Artemis II crew emerges for first time from Orion after splashdown The Artemis II crew began emerging from Orion about 90 minutes after splashdown. This image from NASA TV shows the Artemis II crew members after exiting their Orion capsule. Four Navy divers entered Orion to medically evaluate the astronauts before they were safely brought out.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/artemis-ii-splashdown-return/
